rejected.title: Factors affecting justice in criminal cases
card: The principles of justice are fairness, equality and access. Fairness means impartial, open processes that people can take part in. Access means people can engage with the system on an informed basis.
Equality means people are equal before the law, with the same chance to present their case. Where the same treatment causes disadvantage, steps may be needed to address it.
Cost
Legal representation can be expensive. An accused who cannot afford a lawyer, or cannot get legal aid, may struggle to present their case. This can affect fairness and equality.
Time
Cases can take a long time to reach trial. Delay can weaken witness memories, which can affect the fairness of the trial, and can add stress for the accused and victims.
rejected.remember: Cost and time can each stop the system from being fair, equal or accessible. Cultural differences can too.

Time, because he must wait a long time for his trial
Cultural differences, because court customs are unfamiliar
Jury size, because twelve people will decide his case
a.why: Zoran has no legal help because he cannot pay and legal aid was refused, so this is a cost issue. Nothing in the case mentions a delay, so time is not the factor here.
a.clue: Use only the facts given about Zoran.

b.q: Amara waits two years for her trial. During that time a witness forgets details of what they saw. Which principle of justice is most clearly put at risk?
opts: Fairness, as the trial process relies on weaker testimony
Equality, as she is treated differently from other accused
Access, as she cannot afford to engage a lawyer
Cost, as the delay makes her trial more expensive
b.why: Delay can weaken witness memories, which puts the fairness of the trial process at risk. Cost is tempting, but it is a factor that affects justice, not a principle of justice, and nothing suggests her costs rose.

draft.title: Factors affecting justice in criminal cases
card: The VCE principles of justice are fairness, equality and access. Fairness means fair processes, equality means people are treated the same way, and access means people can understand and take part in the system.
Cost
Legal representation can be expensive. An accused who cannot afford a lawyer, or cannot get legal aid, may struggle to present their case. This can affect fairness and equality.
Time
Cases can take a long time to reach trial. Delay can leave an accused waiting, may weaken witness memories, and can add stress for victims. This can affect fairness and access.
Cultural differences

Differences in language, customs or beliefs can make court processes hard to follow. A person may not fully understand what is said or may feel unable to take part. This can affect access and fairness.
draft.remember: Cost, time and cultural differences can each stop the system from being fair, equal or accessible.

a.q: Zoran is accused of theft but cannot afford a lawyer and is refused legal aid. Which factor is most directly limiting justice for him?
opts: Cost, because he may be unable to present his case well
Time, because his case will be delayed before trial
Cultural differences, because court customs are unfamiliar
Jury size, because twelve people will decide his case
a.why: His problem is that he cannot pay for legal help, so this is a cost issue. Delay is a different factor, and the card does not link it to losing a lawyer.
a.clue: Ask what Zoran is unable to pay for.

b.q: Amara waits two years for her trial. During that time a witness forgets details of what they saw. Which principle of justice is most clearly put at risk?
opts: Fairness, because the evidence may be less reliable
Equality, because she is treated differently by the court
Access, because she cannot afford legal advice
Fairness, because the trial will be held before a jury
b.why: Delay can weaken witness memories, which puts fairness of the process at risk. Nothing in the case suggests she is treated differently from others or cannot afford a lawyer, so the other options do not fit.
b.clue: Look at what delay did to the evidence.

a.best: Cost, because he may be unable to present his case well

b.best: Fairness, because the evidence may be less reliable
